title: Respect and acceptance of diversity in health care – Development, implementation and evaluation of an online learn tool for health professions
summary: In Germany, many different people live who differ, for example, in terms of gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or age. This diversity can lead to disadvantages for people in the healthcare system. To reduce these disadvantages, diversity competence is a crucial factor. In this study, a new online learning tool for students and trainees of various healthcare professions is being developed, tested, and evaluated.
conditions: systematic diversity competence training covering various dimensions of diversity is not standardised in the German healthcare training landscape

interventions.name:
Students and vocational trainees at the campus
of Hannover Medical School will participate in an online learning tool for diversity conpetence developement. Behavioral and treatment related
changes will be assessed using guideline-based interviews and user as well as usage data of the online progr
